abstract: Prognosis and treatment of HCG-positive seminomas with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells are still a matter of discussion. Between 1977 and 1982 the serum HCG and alpha-feto protein levels were determined in a prospective study of a total of 51 patients presenting with histologically proven pure seminomas. A total of 13 of the 51 patients with pure seminoma had elevated serum HCG levels, but all of them were negative for alpha-feto protein. On clinical examination six patients had tumor Stage I, six had had tuor Stage II A-B and one patient had a tumor Stage III. The clinical stage was not found to correlate with HCG levels. In six patients presenting with tumors of clinical Stage II who underwent orchiectomy and subsequently radiation therapy there was a decrease in HCG levels following therapy. Five patients were followed for five years after therapy had been discontinued. There is no indication of a relapse in four patients, and the patients are negative or HCG. One patient suffering from a tumor, Stage IIB died three years later as a result of cirhosis of the liver. Autopsy did not reveal any signs of a residual tumor; the serum HCG levels were negative. For the time being HCG-positive seminomas should be classified and treated as a special morphologic form of seminoma.
abstract_ja: 合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴うhCG陽性セミノーマの予後と治療については、いまだ議論が続いている。1977年から1982年にかけて、組織学的に純粋セミノーマと確定された51例を対象に、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびαフェトプロテインを測定する前向き研究を行った。純粋セミノーマ51例中13例で血清hCGが上昇していたが、全例でαフェトプロテインは陰性であった。臨床所見では、6例が病期I、6例が病期IIA-B、1例が病期IIIであった。臨床病期とhCG値との間に相関は認められなかった。病期IIの6例では、精巣摘除術の後に放射線療法を行ったところ、治療後にhCG値の低下が認められた。治療終了後5年間追跡した5例のうち、4例では再発の兆候がなくhCGは陰性であった。病期IIBの1例は3年後に肝硬変で死亡した。剖検では残存腫瘍の所見はなく、血清hCG値も陰性であった。現時点では、hCG陽性セミノーマはセミノーマの特殊な形態型として分類・治療すべきである。
